## Citation

Murphy, J.A., Barrantes-Reynolds, R., Kocherlakota, R., Bond, J.P., & Greenblatt, M.S. (2004). [The CDKN2A Database: Integrating Allelic Variants with Evolution, Structure, Function, and Disease Association.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15365986/) *Human Mutation*, 24(4), 296-304.

## Summary

This was one of my very first papers. Working alongside Joan Murphy (now an MD) and Dr. Marc Greenblatt, we built a database integrating genetic variants with evolutionary, structural, functional, and clinical data for CDKN2A (p16) — a key tumor suppressor gene. The actual online database is no longer available unfortunately.

In this work I contributed with all the programming (at that time it was in Perl, Php and maybe some C++), database development, and bioinformatic analysis, and also continually collaborated with Joan and Marc, it was a pleasure to work with them and a great introduction to multidisciplinary scientific collaboration.
